mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.building_code, b.building_name, b.gender_restriction, b.education_level_scope, b.resident_scope, b.enabled, c.campus_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS room_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bed.operational_status <> 'RETIRED' THEN bed.id END) AS bed_count FROM dormitory_building b JOIN campus c ON c.id = b.campus_id LEFT JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.building_id = b.id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.floor_id = f.id LEFT JOIN bed ON bed.room_id = r.id GROUP BY b.id, b.building_code, b.building_name, b.gender_restriction, b.education_level_scope, b.resident_scope, b.enabled, c.campus_name ORDER BY b.building_code
SELECT id FROM campus WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dormitory_building (campus_id, building_code, building_name, gender_restriction, education_level_scope, resident_scope, enabled) VALUES (#{campusId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{educationScope}, #{residentScope}, 1)

INSERT INTO dormitory_floor (building_id, floor_number, floor_name, enabled) VALUES
(#{buildingId}, #{floor}, CONCAT(#{floor}, '层'), 1)
mapper.select: SELECT id, gender_restriction AS building_gender_restriction, education_level_scope AS building_education_level_scope, resident_scope AS building_resident_scope FROM dormitory_building WHERE id = #{buildingId} AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room (floor_id, room_number, room_type, capacity, gender_restriction, education_level_scope, resident_scope, operational_status, remark) VALUES (#{floorId}, #{roomNumber}, #{roomType}, #{capacity}, #{gender}, #{educationScope}, #{residentScope}, #{status}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO bed (room_id, bed_code, bed_type, position_index, operational_status) VALUES
(#{roomId}, CONCAT('B', #{position}), 'LOFT_BED_DESK', #{position}, 'ENABLED')
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.floor_id, r.room_number, r.room_type, r.capacity, r.gender_restriction, r.education_level_scope, r.resident_scope, r.operational_status, r.remark, r.state_version, r.version, b.gender_restriction AS building_gender_restriction, b.education_level_scope AS building_education_level_scope, b.resident_scope AS building_resident_scope FROM room r JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building b ON b.id = f.building_id WHERE r.id = #{roomId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bed WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND operational_status <> 'RETIRED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_assignment ra JOIN student s ON s.id = ra.student_id WHERE ra.room_id = #{roomId} AND ra.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( s.gender <> #{gender} OR (#{residentScope} = 'DOMESTIC_ONLY' AND s.student_category <> 'DOMESTIC') OR (#{residentScope} = 'INTERNATIONAL_ONLY' AND s.student_category <> 'INTERNATIONAL') OR (#{educationScope} = 'UNDERGRADUATE_ONLY' AND COALESCE(s.degree_level, '') <> 'UNDERGRADUATE') OR (#{educationScope} = 'GRADUATE_ONLY' AND COALESCE(s.degree_level, '') NOT IN ('MASTER','DOCTOR','MASTER_DOCTOR')) )
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET capacity = #{capacity}, gender_restriction = #{gender}, education_level_scope = #{educationScope}, resident_scope = #{residentScope}, operational_status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, state_version = state_version + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
